versions.changelog: Tighten AI-code pre-merge review workflow: stricter evidence handling, risk calibration, security/privacy pass, paste-mode rules, and validation reporting.

Initial release: pre-merge review for AI-generated PRs, diffs, patches, and pasted code with MERGE/FIX FIRST/REJECT/BLOCKED decision, risk rating, security/privacy checks, scope creep review, and missing-test guidance.
